learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to start and end our sentences like grammar superstars!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Every sentence starts with a big Capital Letter. It is the boss of the sentence! For example: A cat plays.
A sentence always ends with a tiny dot called a Full Stop. It tells us the sentence is over. It means stop and take a breath!
Special names always start with a Big Letter too. Your beautiful name starts with a Big Letter! For example: Rohan, Neha, India.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Be a Grammar Detective!
fun_activity.instructions: Write your full name on a piece of paper. Did you start it with a big Capital Letter? Now write a short sentence about yourself and end it with a Full Stop!

quick_recap: ⭐ Always start your sentence with a Big Capital Letter.
⭐ Always put a tiny Full Stop dot at the very end.
⭐ Your special name always starts with a Big Letter!
